 'The Circle' Host Tinx Talks Changes in New Version, Catfishing & More
 Avery Thompson Tue, November 17, 2026 at 10:09 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Tinx from 'The Circle' - The Circle is entering its Tinx era. The hit reality series has moved to Hulu, with social media sensation Tinx as host. The author, TikTok star, and radio host is thrilled about this next chapter and knows how much The Circle means to reality TV fans.
 "I'm taking this responsibility very seriously," she told TV Insider. "I know that there are a lot of loyal fans from the Netflix Circle . I have a radio show. I play it pretty fast and loose on there, but this I'm taking very seriously. It's a big responsibility, and I just want to make everybody proud. It's a new chapter, which is really exciting."
 Tinx was well aware of the show before she became the host and could have seen herself as a cast member at one point. The first season, which aired on Netflix in 2020, was before she skyrocketed to fame as an influencer. "I think I would have jumped at the opportunity to get on TV and to play the game of social strategy," she said.
 The Circle features celebrity and civilian players entering the apartments, competing to become the most popular player. In the end, only one contestant will be crowned the winner and take home the $100,000 grand prize. The Hulu version will be incorporating a few changes, including audience voting. "But it's not the voting you might think," Tinx admitted. "It's not obvious voting. It's very much causal drama voting, which I obviously love. Also, for the first time, there's going to be celebrities in The Circle , so they're going to be playing alongside the civilians, which is amazing."

 Celebrities include Hannah Brown , Sasha Farber , Layla Taylor , and more. Since this is The Circle we're talking about, we'll get to see who is an expert at catfishing. Tinx has never been shy about sharing her hot takes about dating, so we had to bring up catfishing — in and out of T he Circle .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "In The Circle , I'm for it. I think it makes the game so funny, and out of The Circle , I'm against it," Tinx explained. "I have a rule. All your dating app pictures should be from last year. That's my rule. Anything further back, I'm like, that ain't you anymore."
